COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
AO No. 226 of 2025 
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
Mr. Shailabh Pandey, learned counsel
for the appellant.
2. This appeal has been filed under 
Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, 
against the award dated 16.04.2025, passed 
by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal 
/4th Additional District Judge, Haridwar, in 
Motor Accident Claim Petition No. 03 of 2023, 
by which, the learned Tribunal has awarded 
a total sum of Rs. 35,49,235/- as 
compensation with interest from the date of 
petition till its actual payment. 
2. As an interim measure, it is provided 
that in case the appellant deposits 50% of the 
amount awarded before the Tribunal 
concerned, the effect and operation of the 
order dated 16.04.2025, passed by learned 
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/4th
Additional District Judge, Haridwar in Motor 
Accident Claim Petition No. 03 of 2023, shall 
remain stayed, till the next date of listing. 
6. Issue notice to the respondents. Steps 
be taken within a week. Summon the lower 
court record. 
7. List this matter for admission on 14.08.
2025. 
 (Subhash Upadhyay, J.)

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
I.A. No.2 of 2025 (Money Withdrawal Appl.)
In
A.O. No.226 of 2025
Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Shailabh Pandey, Advocate for the 
appellant. 
Mr. Nikhil Singhal, Advocate for 
respondent nos.1, 4 & 5.
2. This money withdrawal application has 
been filed by claimants for withdrawal of the 
amount of compensation deposited by the 
Insurance Company before learned Tribunal. 
3. Learned Tribunal had awarded a sum of 
₹35,49,235/- as compensation to the claimants. 
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that 
the appellant has deposited 50% of the 
awarded amount with the concerned tribunal, in 
terms of the order passed by this Court.
4. Having regard to the facts and 
circumstances of the case, money withdrawal 
application is allowed. Learned Tribunal is 
directed to release 50% of the deposited 
amount in favour of claimants proportionately, 
without asking any security. The remaining 
amount shall be invested in an interest bearing 
scheme of a nationalized bank.
5. List on 13.11.2025.
 (Alok Mahra, J.) 26.09.2025
Arpan
